description: On the bed in front of the hands there’s a pile of small, colorful beads, a length of string with a partially beaded section, and a tape dispenser off to the right. The left hand steadies and pinches the string near its end while the right hand reaches up to the bead pile to pick up a single bead, then brings it back down to the string and uses both hands together to thread the bead onto the string and slide it into place.
